audit.whatIsWrong: Twisted Advance is described as a lock-on root to 'dodge', with no cooldown and no mention that he is untargetable during it, and Sap Magic's heal is treated as passive background sustain.
audit.why: Kit file: Twisted Advance is 14/13/12/11/10s at 525 range and he is UNTARGETABLE while dashing — telling a player to dodge a targeted dash is not counterplay; timing around the 14-10s window is. Sap Magic's heal cooldown is reduced every time he casts a spell OR IS STRUCK BY AN ENEMY SPELL, so your own Obliterate and aura accelerate his healing — the single most important and least obvious fact in this lane. Bramble Smash is 7/6.5/6/5.5/5s at 600 range; Sapling Toss is 1100 range on 18/17/16/15/14s; Nature's Grasp is 130/110/90s at 3000 range.
audit.corrected: dosFull[0].d, report[5].t, dontsFull[1].d and dontsFull[2].d now carry the cooldowns, the untargetable window and the Sap Magic acceleration.

audit.whatIsWrong: Packet flagged zero cooldown-sequencing advice on the page, and nothing warned about Nature's Grasp cutting a dashless Mordekaiser's retreat.
audit.why: Nature's Grasp is a 3000-range advancing wall that roots. Mordekaiser has no dash, so Flash is the only answer and it has to be saved for the wall rather than spent on damage.
audit.corrected: report[9].t now sequences it: hold Flash for the wall, commit once R and W are spent.

notes: Six of seven chart rows inverted on both layers; fixed in matched pairs per the packet and the mirror, which had already flipped its side. The most useful new fact on the page is that Sap Magic's heal cooldown is reduced when Maokai is STRUCK by an enemy spell — a Mordekaiser grinding him with Darkness Rise is actively refilling his sustain, which is why the extended trade underperforms and why anti-heal matters more here than the generic Liandry's line suggests. All three packet suspectNames are false positives.
